title: Wednesday Quick Tip
subtitle: Requests for more practice
hook: A parent asks if you can add another practice each week.
intro: You already give the time you have.
statement: More practice is not always more learning.
q1: Do you suggest things to try at home —
q2: or explain why the current schedule is enough?
q3: How much time do you have to give?
t1: Both can work. But volunteering lasts
t2: when you set limits that fit your life.
ctaLines: Home drills. A tee and a net. The schedule stays.
Suggest home work or hold the line?
ctaPrompt: Share your habit below. There are no wrong answers.
caption:
A parent asks if you can add another practice each week.
Their child wants more. You already give the time you have.
More practice is not always more learning.
Suggest practice at home or explain the schedule. Both can work.
How do you answer? Share your habit in the comments.
